new_promises.statement: Expect gold loan portfolio to cross 5 percent of total AUM by FY27.
new_promises.quote: We foresee gold loan portfolio to probably cross 5-odd percent of total AUM by FY'27.
new_promises.speaker: Rajeev Jain

new_promises.statement: Expect to add 15 to 17 million new customers in FY27.
new_promises.quote: we continue to be confident of adding 15 - 17 million new customers in FY27.
new_promises.speaker: Rajeev Jain

new_promises.statement: Expect 20% to 24% AUM growth in FY27.

new_promises.speaker: Rajeev Jain

new_promises.statement: Expect ROA guidance for FY27 to be 4.4% to 4.6%.

new_promises.statement: Expect return on equity guidance for FY27 to be 19% to 20%.
